achievements.name: Speed demon
achievements.description: Achieve a sustained speed of 150m/s below 500m altitude in designer with a vehicle you've made yourself. Neter standard physics.

achievements.name: Wing clipper
achievements.description: Kill 20 planes in campaign, story mission or adventure

achievements.name: An explosive combination
achievements.description: Build a  1 million damage explosive combo in the campaigns/missions/adventures of built in planets (using standard game constants)

achievements.name: Peak performance
achievements.description: Get one of your own designs  beyond version 100

achievements.name: What missiles?
achievements.description: Destroy 1000 missiles in the campaigns/missions/adventures of built in planets (using standard game constants)

achievements.name: Espionage
achievements.description: Get a unit that provides the maximum strategic radar range in a campaign

achievements.name: Battle master
achievements.description: Score 5 battle merits in a single (preset difficulty) campaign battle. You'll need to attack a force approximately 10 times your volume and win with 60% of your volume undestroyed to achieve this.

achievements.name: The bigger they are...
achievements.description: Defeat 5 small (<30k volume) godlies in (fixed difficulty) campaigns, missions, or adventures on built in planets using standard game constants

achievements.name: ... the harder they fall
achievements.description: Defeat 5 large (>30k volume) godlies in (fixed difficulty) campaigns, missions or adventures on built-in planets using standard game constants

achievements.name: Worm hole addict
achievements.description: Reach level 100 in adventure mode on Neter using standard game constants

achievements.name: The assassin
achievements.description: Defeat a unit in the campaigns/adventures/missions of built-in planets whilst it still has 99% of its blocks alive

achievements.name: Eyrie survivors' club
achievements.description: Defeat an Eyrie in fixed difficulty campaign/mission/adventures of Neter.

achievements.name: The lord taketh...
achievements.description: Make a total of 1 million commodities for your team in (fixed difficulty) campaigns of built-in planets

achievements.name: ...and the lord gifteth away
achievements.description: Gift a total of 1 million commodities to your forces  in a (fixed difficulty) campaign on a built-in planet.

achievements.name: Heavy weapons
achievements.description: Save a sub-object that costs more than 50,000 materials

achievements.name: Alpha strike
achievements.description: Kill 500 volume per second in a campaign battle (on fixed-difficulty built-in campaigns with standard game constants). Measured when the battle ends.

achievements.name: Hey, I glow in the dark
achievements.description: Use more than 15 RTGs on a vehicle you've made yourself. Unlocked in designer.

achievements.name: Petty squabbles
achievements.description: Take part in a campaign battle with 3 or more teams involved in it (including you). Fixed-difficulty built-in campaigns only.

achievements.name: Et tu, Brute?
achievements.description: Declare war on an ally in a (fixed difficulty) built-in campaign

achievements.name: Planetary defence force
achievements.description: Kill 50 Scarlet Dawn units in Neter's (fixed-difficulty) campaigns, missions or adventures (standard game constants).
